units.source_text: 你这番好意难得啊，我倒是想要点我想要的东西。

en.t: Since you are being so kind, I would rather ask for something I actually want.

units.source_text: 近来我很想插花，不过花太贵了。

en.t: Lately I have wanted to arrange flowers, but flowers are far too expensive.

units.source_text: 眼下全阁恰好是菖蒲、燕子花开时节，

en.t: Right now, all around the temple, it happens to be the season when irises and rabbit-ear irises are in bloom,

units.source_text: 你是否给我搞四五枚燕子花，或者是蓓营，或者是刚绽开的，或者是已经盛开的都可以，

en.t: so could you get me four or five rabbit-ear irises, whether they are buds, just opening, or already in full bloom,
and add six or seven stalks of horsetail reed.

units.source_text: 今晚摘也行啊，夜里你带到我的住处来好吗？"

en.t: You may pick them tonight if you like; would you bring them to my lodging during the night?
